description: The global listening party (owner, 23 November 2026: one Opus stream to a global audience, ramped to tens of thousands), sized for 20,000 listeners of 1 ms Opus Custom (opus-1) with 2 paths each (5,000 in sydney, 5,000 in london, 5,000 in newyork, 5,000 in tokyo), merged topology: in each region two forwarders and 38 edges in sydney, 38 edges in london, 38 edges in newyork, 38 edges in tokyo, all g6-dedicated-2; listener load hosts 21 x g6-dedicated-4 in sydney, 11 x g6-dedicated-8 in london, 11 x g6-dedicated-8 in newyork, 11 x g6-dedicated-8 in tokyo (needletail-load for the UDP listeners, ntcmp for the LL-HLS ones) and a g6-dedicated-4 view host for the full probes, on the region's VLAN (Linode does not bill VLAN traffic; 5,000 UDP listeners of 1 ms PCM over the public network would be about 12 TB an hour of billed transfer), and a self-hosted LiveKit SFU (g6-dedicated-2) per region; the contributor alone on a g6-dedicated-4 in London, its standby contrib-lon-b alone on another (both publish the same parts) with its source host lon-src. Dedicated plans only. Sydney first: the core of the region short of capacity is created first; the run works without it (lab up --optional-sites sydney, or --without-sites sydney). The listener hosts are created last, in batches: the lab is kept when the account refuses some (listeners_missing), and scale-run.py fits its steps to the hosts that exist. Standby edges (syd-edge-38, lon-edge-38, new-edge-38, tok-edge-38): created, held out by the deploy setting standby_edges until they are started in (deploy start --nodes, or the autoscaler). Autoscale slots (syd-dist-c, syd-edge-39, syd-edge-40, lon-dist-c, lon-edge-39, lon-edge-40, new-dist-c, new-edge-39, new-edge-40, tok-dist-c, tok-edge-39, tok-edge-40): in every peer list from the first push, created only by the autoscaler (lab add), never by up or grow. Up creates 226 nodes at $19.062 an hour; with every slot 238 nodes at $19.710, so the lab's ceilings are NEEDLETAIL_LINODE_MAX_NODES=238 and NEEDLETAIL_LINODE_MAX_HOURLY_USD=19.75 or more. Planning figures (the proving run replaces them): 400,000 client datagrams a second fill an edge, planned to 70%; 0.0055 vCPU per one-path listener of 1,000 parts a second on a listener host, planned to 70%. Generated by scripts/scale_topology.py party; the plan, its cost and its assumptions are in deploy/low-latency/PARTY.md.
